name: DesignCraft
description: DesignCraft is an open-source page and layout design editor written from scratch in pure Rust by the ArtCraft team. It ships as a native universal macOS app (DMG and Homebrew cask) and also runs on Windows and Linux. Like all Crafting Apps it is young and moving fast: v0.10.0 landed in October 2026.

zh.description: DesignCraft 是 ArtCraft 团队从零开始、用纯 Rust 编写的开源版面设计编辑器。提供 macOS universal 原生版本（DMG 与 Homebrew cask），同时支持 Windows 和 Linux。和所有 Crafting Apps 一样年轻而迭代飞快：v0.10.0 于 2026 年 10 月发布。
